svg.title: Forcing, domain and exponent: exact parametric solution families

cc:Work.dc:title: Forcing, domain and exponent: exact parametric solution families
cc:Work.dc:description: Three analytic scalar Dirichlet model families, evaluated from lecture formulas. Blue: full family; orange: parameter mu=0.5. Not neural-network predictions or research experiments.
